mapper.sql: CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(m.nickname), '') IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(m.nickname)) = LOWER(TRIM(m.email)) THEN '회원' ELSE m.nickname END

p.id, p.parent_id, p.scope, p.exchange, p.market, p.symbol, p.title, p.body, p.author, AS author_name, CASE WHEN profile.avatar_id IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/profiles/avatars/' || profile.avatar_id ELSE NULL END AS avatar_url, CASE WHEN p.author = #{viewer} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id AND l.member_id = #{viewer}) AS liked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_posts c WHERE c.parent_id = p.id) AS comment_count, p.image_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at
FROM community_posts p JOIN members m ON m.email = p.author LEFT JOIN member_profiles profile ON profile.member_id = m.email
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE p.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT 21 OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts (parent_id, scope, exchange, market, symbol, title, body, author, image_id, image_data) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{scope}, #{exchange}, #{market}, #{symbol}, #{title}, #{body}, #{author}, #{imageId}, #{imageData})
mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND author = #{author}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_posts WHERE id = #{id} AND author = #{author}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_likes (post_id, member_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{author}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_likes WHERE post_id = #{id} AND member_id = #{author}
mapper.select: SELECT image_data FROM community_posts WHERE image_id = #{imageId}
